name: haalendar
description: +++===+++ 2026-10-14 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-017. Root task entry point (ADR-0003): one place to run frontend and backend checks.

scripts.backend:check: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src tests && uv run pytest
scripts.security:audit: pnpm audit --audit-level low && cd backend && uv export --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt -q | uv run pip-audit -r /dev/stdin --require-hashes --disable-pip --strict --progress-spinner off
